title: Count lines, words and characters

cases.name: extra spaces, blank line, no final newline
a missing file: exit code 1 and nothing on stdout
no argument: exit code 1 and nothing on stdout

hints: Read one character at a time: int c; while ((c = fgetc(f)) != EOF)
A word starts when you see a non-space character and the previous character was a space (or the start of the file). Keep an in_word flag.
isspace from <ctype.h> is true for spaces, tabs and newlines.
